_README: API list prices for the two non-Claude Trinity legs, in USD per 1,000,000 tokens.
WHY THIS FILE EXISTS: the LLM Usage tab was once 6x wrong because stale prices were
hardcoded in Python (audit 2026-09-16). Prices now live in data, dated and sourced,
so correcting one is an edit here plus a dashboard restart - never a code change.
HOW TO EDIT: set the numbers, set the model's 'verified_on' to the date YOU checked
the vendor page, and bump 'pricing_version'. A price left null renders as 'unpriced'
on the dashboard - that is deliberate. NEVER guess a number to fill a null: an honest
gap is cheaper than a confident wrong figure.
Claude's own prices are NOT here - they live in engine/common/usage_stats.py
MODEL_PRICES and are governed by usage_recalibrate.py.
note_on_actual_cost: Both assistants are flat-rate subscriptions (ChatGPT Plus $20/mo, Gemini free-tier key $0/mo). These prices produce an API-EQUIVALENT figure - what the same traffic would have cost on a metered API - for comparison against the Claude column. They are not money spent.

gemini.meter: self-imposed 200 calls/day; Google RPM/TPM/RPD per model

codex._price_unknown_note: Slugs with no published price (Codex's hidden internal ones) are costed at the account's default model and flagged 'inferred' on the dashboard, so the API-equivalent column stays complete without pretending the rate is known.

gemini._free_tier_note: Calls made with the AI Studio free-tier key cost $0 regardless of the numbers below. The numbers exist only to answer 'what would this have cost on the paid API'.
